The '''Delphon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delphon/Legends|Delphon]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' mistakenly depicts Delphon in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
